98058184.s: Serves cafeteria-style food in a modern, distinctive way. A breakfast restaurant. Open 5:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m.
98058184.b: Maqsaf serves cafeteria-style food in a modern, distinctive way, and is known for its halloumi sandwich, scrambled eggs and premium cheese manousheh. It offers an authentic cafeteria experience at reasonable prices, although some visitors prefer to order takeaway rather than sit inside. For contact or reservations: 0506539250. Open from 6:00 a.m. to 12:00 midnight.
98058184.a: Mohammed Bin Yasar St, Al Mohammadiyyah, Riyadh 12364

98057992.s: Serves a variety of breakfast dishes from around the world. A breakfast restaurant. Open 8:00 a.m. to 4:00 p.m.
98057992.b: Opla serves a variety of breakfast dishes from around the world, and is known for Turkish eggs and banana French toast, with plant-based milk alternatives available. It is a small, intimate place that fills up quickly, but the quality of the food makes up for it. For contact or reservations: 0552999126. Open from 7:00 a.m. to 4:00 p.m. (closed Sundays).
98057992.a: Prince Mohammed Bin Salman Bin Abdulaziz Rd, Ar Rabi, Riyadh 13315

98057991.s: Serves a varied menu of distinctive food along with tea and coffee. A breakfast restaurant. Open 8:30 a.m. to 12:30 a.m.
98057991.b: NOOA serves a varied menu of distinctive food along with tea and coffee, and is known for high-quality coffee and desserts. It has a calm, comfortable atmosphere suited to special occasions, and attentive service that notices details, such as offering a balloon and a flower for special occasions. For contact or reservations: 920007612. Open from 8:30 a.m. to 1:00 a.m.
98057991.a: Umm Al Hamam Al Gharbi, Riyadh 12329

98057989.s: Serves a variety of breakfast dishes from around the world. A breakfast restaurant. Open 6:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m.
98057989.b: The Breakfast Club serves a variety of breakfast dishes from around the world, and is known for Mexican eggs and fluffy vanilla pancakes, with the option to have eggs cooked as you like (scrambled or fried). It has a lively atmosphere with warm, modern decor, and is very busy, especially on holidays. For contact or reservations: 0555330865. Open from 6:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m.
98057989.a: Northern Ring Rd, Al Ghadir, Riyadh 13311

98057988.s: A restaurant specializing in a varied and tasty selection of breakfast dishes. A breakfast restaurant. Open 6:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m.
98057988.b: Brekkie is a restaurant specializing in a varied and tasty selection of breakfast dishes all day, and is known for date and apple French toast and creamy scrambled eggs. It has a refreshing, comfortable atmosphere and is an ideal place for small celebrations such as birthdays. For contact or reservations: 0599170936. Open from 6:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m.
98057988.a: Abi Bakr As Siddiq Branch Rd, Al Mursilat, Riyadh 12464

98057987.s: An authentic restaurant with the charm of the past and a lovely Palestinian atmosphere. A breakfast restaurant. Open 5:00 p.m. to 1:00 a.m.
98057987.b: Al-Kofeia is an authentic restaurant with the charm of the past and a lovely Palestinian atmosphere. As soon as you sit down, you are welcomed with sticks of fresh pita bread toasted with za'atar and olive oil. It is known for its chicken pie and distinctive hummus, and has elegant heritage decor with special attention to details such as places to hang bags and coats. For contact or reservations: 0553453888. Open from 5:00 a.m. to 2:00 a.m.
98057987.a: Prince Mohammed Bin Abdulaziz Rd, Al Olaya, Riyadh 12241

98057986.s: A breakfast and brunch restaurant serving tasty, varied dishes. A breakfast restaurant. Open 7:00 a.m. to 2:00 p.m.
98057986.b: Lunch Room is a breakfast and brunch restaurant serving tasty, varied dishes that blend Eastern and Western flavors, and is known for Dutch eggs with a Dutch baby pancake, and French toast. It is one of the most popular breakfast spots in Riyadh, so much so that you may sometimes wait up to a full hour on weekends, with a phone-based queue tracking system. For contact or reservations: 0558263732. Open from 7:00 a.m. to 2:30 p.m.

98057985.s: Coming from London to Riyadh, serving the best and finest fresh baked goods. A breakfast restaurant. Open 7:00 a.m. to 11:00 p.m.
98057985.b: Chestnut Bakery comes from London to Riyadh, serving the best and finest fresh baked goods at a recognized international standard. It is known for sourdough bread and small pastries with mozzarella and roasted tomato, and is one of the best breakfast destinations in the city, although its prices are relatively high. Open from 7:00 a.m. to 11:00 p.m.

98057984.s: For a different taste, serving a tempting breakfast menu with a variety of international and Arabic dishes. A breakfast restaurant. Open 7:00 a.m. to 12:00 a.m.
98057984.b: Arcomi is for those with a different taste, serving a tempting breakfast menu with a variety of international and Arabic dishes. It is known for its shakshuka and karak; the ratings for these vary, but the rest of the menu is highly praised. It has carefully designed elegant decor and refined service, and is a favorite venue for special events such as book launches. For contact or reservations: 0554075757. Open from 7:00 a.m. to 1:00 a.m.

98057964.s: For lovers of authentic shawarma flavor, known for serving the best shawarma in Riyadh. A shawarma restaurant. Open 5:30 a.m. to 3:00 a.m.
98057964.b: Mama Noura is for lovers of authentic shawarma flavor and is known for serving the best shawarma in Riyadh, along with broasted chicken, foul and fresh falafel. It is one of the most popular and busiest fast-food restaurants in the city, with excellent reviews, although some visitors note that the juices can be overly sweet. For contact or reservations: 920012026. Open from 5:30 a.m. to 3:00 a.m.
98057964.a: King Abdullah Rd, Ar Rahmaniyyah, Riyadh 12343

98057963.s: Serves authentic shawarma with a distinctive marinade, alongside delicious crispy fries. A shawarma restaurant. Open 12:00 p.m. to 3:00 a.m.
98057963.b: Shawarma Abu Rayan serves authentic shawarma with a distinctive marinade alongside delicious crispy fries, and also offers gluten-free options in a dedicated kitchen area. It has positive reviews for the quality of its ingredients and cleanliness, although some visitors note that the special options are pricey. For contact or reservations: 0507877444. Open from 12:00 noon to 3:30 a.m.
98057963.a: King Fahd Branch Rd, Al Malqa, Riyadh 13521

98057962.s: One of the best restaurants for shawarma in all its forms, with many other distinctive dishes. A shawarma restaurant. Open 5:00 a.m. to 4:00 a.m.
98057962.b: Shawarma House is one of the best restaurants for shawarma in all its forms, alongside many other distinctive dishes such as mishaltat and shakshuka. It runs on a self-service system with modern decor and even offers low-carb options, making it an all-round destination for different tastes and diets. For contact or reservations: 920016666. Open from 5:00 a.m. to 4:00 a.m.
98057962.a: Prince Mamduh Bin Abdulaziz St, As Sulimaniyah, Riyadh 12245

98057961.s: Serves shawarma in three types of bread in a unique, creative style. A shawarma restaurant. Open 11:30 a.m. to 4:00 a.m.
98057961.b: Mareez serves shawarma in three types of bread in a unique, creative style, giving visitors the freedom to choose the texture they prefer. It has comfortable, clean seating, and is a name long associated with fond memories for shawarma lovers in the area. For contact or reservations: 0580617426. Open from 11:30 a.m. to 4:00 a.m.
98057961.a: Prince Abdulaziz Ibn Thunayyan St, An Nakheel, Riyadh 12393

98057959.s: For meat lovers, serving the best meat shawarma alongside the famous kibbeh with its distinctive flavor. A shawarma restaurant. Open 1:00 p.m. to 2:00 a.m.
98057959.b: Usta Asim is for meat lovers, serving the best meat shawarma alongside the famous kibbeh with its distinctive flavor, and specializes exclusively in fresh beef cooked in the traditional way. It has excellent reviews from visitors as a leading destination for lovers of meat shawarma in Riyadh. For contact or reservations: 0553260491. Open from 11:00 a.m. to 3:00 a.m.
98057959.a: Southern Ring Branch Rd, Shubra, Riyadh 12988

98057958.s: Known for serving shawarma in red bread with its authentic, tasty flavor. A shawarma restaurant. Open 12:30 p.m. to 3:00 a.m.
98057958.b: Amazing Shawarma is known for serving shawarma in red bread with its authentic, tasty flavor, using a distinctive bread that differs from most other restaurants. It is very busy in the evenings and on weekends, so visitors may need to wait a little for a table. For contact or reservations: 0112261808. Open from 1:00 p.m. to 3:30 a.m.
98057958.a: Prince Mamdouh Bin Abdulaziz St, As Sulimaniyah, Riyadh 12245

98057957.s: Serves authentic shawarma alongside many baked goods prepared daily in its own bakeries. A shawarma restaurant.
98057957.b: Boo Shawarma serves authentic shawarma alongside many baked goods prepared daily in its own bakeries, which ensures consistently fresh ingredients. The place is small, so it is mostly ordered through delivery apps. Long-time customers have fond memories of it, despite some inconsistency in service quality recently.
98057957.a: Salim Ibn Maqil, An Nakheel, Riyadh 12393

98057956.s: Serves beef and chicken shawarma in a unique style with a delicious taste, plus its famous basbousa. A shawarma restaurant. Open 12:00 p.m. to 4:00 a.m.
98057956.b: Shawarma Al Balad serves beef and chicken shawarma in a unique style with a delicious taste, along with the famous basbousa the place is known for. It has economical, reasonable prices, although some visitors note a slight variation in the amount of filling at times. For contact or reservations: 0583509912. Open from 3:00 p.m. to 3:00 a.m.

98057955.s: Known for tasty shawarma and grilled meats in the traditional way, open 24 hours. A shawarma restaurant.
98057955.b: Shawarma Jalila is known for tasty shawarma and grilled meats in the traditional way, and is open 24 hours a day, making it an ideal choice at any time. It is known for its akawi shawarma and light, well-balanced garlic sauce, and is very popular, although some visitors note inconsistency in the quality of the filling between visits. For contact or reservations: 920025199. Open around the clock.
98057955.a: Southern Ring Branch Rd, As Suwaidi Al Gharbi, Riyadh 51022

98057805.s: A luxury restaurant specializing in high-quality grilled meats such as wagyu and bone marrow. A distinctive restaurant. Open 1:00 p.m. to 2:00 a.m.
98057805.b: HABRA is a luxury restaurant specializing in high-quality grilled meats such as wagyu and bone marrow, and is known for its sweet chicken fingers and distinctive lychee dessert. It is located inside MEFIC Center, with exceptional service that notices small details, such as offering ginger tea to a visitor with a cold. For contact or reservations: 920009587. Open from 1:00 p.m. to 2:00 a.m.
98057805.a: MEFIC Center, Northern Ring Branch Rd, An Nakheel, Riyadh 12385

98057804.s: A luxury restaurant with unique colorful decor and a small gift shop, in the historic Bujairi district. A distinctive restaurant. Open 6:00 p.m. to 1:00 a.m.
98057804.b: Flamingo Room is a luxury restaurant with unique colorful decor that blends flowers and bold colors, along with a small shop for gifts and home products inside the restaurant itself. It is located in the historic Bujairi district and serves creative international dishes, with special attention to celebrations and special occasions such as birthdays. For contact or reservations: 920013253. Open from 6:00 p.m. to 1:00 a.m. (closed Sundays).
98057804.a: 7295 King Faisal Rd, Al Bujairi, Diriyah 13711

98057802.s: A luxury Indian restaurant with unique royal decor that combines authenticity and luxury. A distinctive restaurant. Open 12:00 p.m. to 2:00 a.m.
98057802.b: Shahrukh Khan Restaurant is a luxury Indian restaurant with unique royal decor that combines authenticity and luxury, giving visitors a sense of grandeur from the moment they enter. It serves a wide range of richly spiced Indian dishes, with several complimentary appetizers, and is very busy, especially on weekends, so advance reservations are recommended. For contact or reservations: 0544312621. Open from 12:00 noon to 2:00 a.m.
98057802.a: Khaled Bin Waleed Rd, Qurtubah, Riyadh 13244

98057801.s: A luxury Gulf restaurant with a modern Persian touch in the historic Bujairi district. A distinctive restaurant. Open 6:00 p.m. to 11:45 p.m.
98057801.b: Villa Mamas is a luxury Gulf restaurant with a modern Persian touch in the historic Bujairi district, serving dishes that combine authentic Gulf flavors with refined presentation. It is known for its explosive eggplant dish and lamb, and has a captivating view of the historic terraces, making it an ideal setting for a romantic or family evening. For contact or reservations: 0115201105. Open from 6:00 p.m. to 11:45 p.m.
98057801.a: Unit 20/21, Bujairi Terrace, Al Bujairi, Diriyah 13711

98057800.s: From Saudi chef Hisham Baashen, serving authentic Saudi dishes with a refined modern touch. A distinctive restaurant. Open 12:00 p.m. to 12:00 a.m.
98057800.b: Fi Qalbak is from Saudi chef Hisham Baashen and serves authentic Saudi dishes with a refined modern touch that reflects the richness of local cuisine. It is known for carefully cooked fish and okra dishes, and has elegant decor and a lovely heritage atmosphere that reflects Saudi hospitality culture. For contact or reservations: 0555717072. Open from 12:30 p.m. to 12:00 midnight.
98057800.a: 6685, 3058 Prince Turki Al Awwal Rd, Al Mohammadiyyah, Riyadh 12362

98057799.s: Serves distinctive burgers alongside high-quality meat and seafood dishes. A distinctive restaurant. Open 8:00 a.m. to 12:00 a.m.
98057799.b: Jar serves distinctive burgers alongside high-quality meat and seafood dishes, and is known for the Jar steak, crab salad and lemon pasta. It has exceptional service in which staff remember the names of regular customers, and sometimes surprise them with a free dessert in appreciation of their loyalty. For contact or reservations: 0114645050. Open from 2:00 p.m. to 11:00 p.m.
98057799.a: King Abdulaziz Rd, Al Yasmeen, Riyadh 11564

98057797.s: Known for grilling burgers in a distinctive way and serving the meat without drowning it in sauce. A distinctive restaurant. Open 12:00 p.m. to 2:00 a.m.
98057797.b: Cleaver Burger is known for grilling burgers in a distinctive way that preserves the natural flavor of the meat without drowning it in sauce, and also serves entrecote cuts and grilled meats. Its atmosphere is practical and simple rather than luxurious, with friendly service and distinctive hospitality from the team. For contact or reservations: 0555222444. Open from 11:00 a.m. to 1:30 a.m.
